title: refactor: simplify Discord quest membership
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the UI-only Discord membership endpoint and account-page status lookup
- Keeps membership verification inside the server-side Discord quest evaluator
- Simplifies cached membership results to a boolean while preserving Discord error handling
- Verifies linked members still earn the 1-Pollen `join_discord` reward

Tests:
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npx vitest run test/integration/account-linking.test.ts`
- `npx vitest run test/quests.test.ts`

gist.headline: Quest check, less clutter
gist.blurb: The Discord quest now checks membership where it counts: in the server-side evaluator. Linked hive members can still collect their 1 Pollen without the account page performing an extra little ritual.
gist.summary: Simplified the `join_discord` Quest by removing the UI-only membership endpoint and account-page status lookup, while keeping server-side Discord verification and the 1-Pollen reward for linked members.
gist.impact: Linked Discord members still earn 1 Pollen for `join_discord`, with membership results cached as a simple boolean and fewer account-page requests involved.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy quest-verification garden: Polli follows one clear server-side path from a linked Discord-style badge to a glowing 1-Pollen flower, while an unnecessary extra signpost is peacefully put away. A CRT monitor robot can inspect the single green checkmark, with code-plants and soft garden details showing that the quest still completes.
